content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-105.5. - Additional paid sick leave during a public health emergency.
content.summary:
Additional paid sick leave may be granted to and used by employees during a public
               health emergency in accordance with applicable federal and state law or public health
               orders, and a policy established by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
